title: OIDC UserInfo Claims
description: Standard claims as defined by OpenID Connect Core 1.0, Section 5.1.

sub.description: Subject - Identifier for the End-User at the Issuer.

given_name.description: Given name(s) or first name(s) of the End-User.

family_name.description: Surname(s) or last name(s) of the End-User.

preferred_username.description: Shorthand name by which the End-User wishes to be referred to.

profile.description: URL of the End-User's profile page.

picture.description: URL of the End-User's profile picture.

website.description: URL of the End-User's Web page or blog.

email_verified.description: True if the End-User's e-mail address has been verified.

birthdate.description: End-User's birthday, represented as an ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format.

zoneinfo.description: String from the IANA Time Zone Database representing the End-User's time zone.

locale.description: End-User's locale, represented as a BCP47 language tag.

phone_number_verified.description: True if the End-User's phone number has been verified.

formatted.description: Full mailing address, formatted for display.

street_address.description: Full street address, which MAY include house number, street name, etc.

updated_at.description: Time the End-User's information was last updated, represented as a Unix timestamp.
